description.en: Puts a character at a position and direction at once and sets its motion by name: CMND_SET_POSRY with the four values of _stdPos as separate numbers (x, y, z, rotY in degrees), then CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG to the same spot over 1 frame (so the movement manager agrees with the new place), then CMND_SET_MOTION(_hdl, _motion, 0, 0).
Motion name, e.g. the stand motion 立ち01.

examples.case: Putting the player back before leaving an event (real usage, from ev42010100.nut; Shift-JIS motion names shortened)
